name: breakfast, and breakfast came back
note: An ordinary morning request answered by ordinary morning food. The corpus needed three typical cases and carried one; a corpus that is mostly hard cases teaches the judgement that refusing is the safe answer, and a false 'nothing here' costs a Customer a good answer they were about to get.
